text: When something goes wrong with store money, Scout doesn't stay silent. It opens a Billing task, so a person follows up.
Store problems land in the billing queue, under Unassigned.
Every store money problem is a Billing task. Work it the same day.
Tom's card kept failing, and Stripe ended his auto-ship. Call the family about a new card.
Assign it to yourself, so nobody else calls too.
On the auto-ships list, payment problems shows the same auto-ship,
Other store tasks work the same way: a charge Scout refunded, an auto-ship that didn't start, or a cancel Stripe hasn't confirmed. Each one says what happened and what to do.
The most common mistakes: leaving these tasks until the end of the week, and refunding again in Stripe when Scout already refunded.
Remember: every store money problem lands as a Billing task. Work it the same day.
